name: The Totem of Infliction

guaranteedRewards.name: Totem of Infliction
tooltip: Equip: When struck in combat has a 1% chance of inflicting 75 to 125 Shadow damage to the attacker.

narrative.details:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, adventurer.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble champion, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Very wise of you, adventurer. This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout Azeroth and beyond. When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura. Be brave, fair Champion. You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
